items.headline: Beyond the Best Guess: Improving LLM Solution Coverage with Evolution Strategies
items.summary:
arXiv:2608.12679v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in discovery domains such as math and science. The usual approach is to present the problem to the model and use its answer as the proposed solution. However, beyond this best guess, discovery can be enhanced by increasing test-time compute.
